counterexamples.category: Mặt phẳng gần ngang nhưng không hoàn toàn ngang (Nearly horizontal plane)
counterexamples.expected_math: All polygon vertices V of plane (x - P0)·n = 0 with n=(1,0,6) must satisfy x + 6(z - 1) = 0 (max residual = 0); non-incident points must not be snapped onto the plane.

oracle_failures: Plane plane_nearly_horiz defining point P1 does not satisfy n.(P-P0)=0 (err=9.864e-01)

counterexamples.root_cause: 1) In `research/scene3d-plane-grid-camera` (`frontend/src/simulations/domains/geometry/scene3d-model.ts:1049`), `const ngang = Math.abs(u[2]) > 0.98;` classifies any plane with |u_z| > 0.98 (tilt up to 11.48°, e.g. n=(1,0,6) with |u_z|=0.9864) as strictly horizontal and emits vertices `[diemMp[0]+s, diemMp[1]+t, diemMp[2]]` with constant z, violating (V - P0)·n = 0 by up to 1.18 units. 2) On `main` (`4abc4afb`, `scene3d-model.ts:926`), `daGiacMatPhang` checks `Math.abs(h) <= 1e-3` across all `diemNen`, snapping non-incident points (`Q_non_incident`) into the plane polygon.

counterexamples.category: Mặt phẳng gần đứng (Nearly vertical plane)
counterexamples.expected_math: For plane 100x + z = 0, point S at z=2 must have x = -1/50 = -0.02; approximating a nearly vertical plane (89.43°) by a vertical plane x=0 leaves residual |n·(S-P0)|/||n|| = 0.019999 > 1e-6.

oracle_failures: Plane plane_nearly_vert defining point S does not satisfy n.(P-P0)=0 (err=2.000e-02)

counterexamples.root_cause: Approximating a nearly vertical plane n=(100,0,1) by vertical x=0 violates exact point-plane incidence `|n·(S - P0)| / ||n|| = 2 / sqrt(10001) = 0.019999 > PLANE_TOL`. Furthermore, in frontend `scene3d-model.ts` (`catDaGiacTheoDay`), clipping a nearly vertical plane purely at `zMin = min(diemNen.z)` discards any valid lower half-space constructions when an intersection point lies below `zMin`.

counterexamples.category: Quan hệ vuông góc chưa được chứng nhận (Uncertified perpendicularity relation)
counterexamples.expected_math: Right-angle markers must only be rendered when backed by an explicit mathematical certificate (`perpendicular_witness`, `project_point_to_plane`, `altitude_from_to_plane`, or `plane_perpendicular_to_line`), never from substring matching on `o.id` / `o.label`.

frontend_warnings: FE_UNCERTIFIED_HEIGHT_MARKER on segment doan_cao_gia (['S', 'A']): triggers `laChieuCao` heuristic in scene3d-view.tsx without perpendicularity certificate

counterexamples.root_cause: In `frontend/src/simulations/domains/geometry/scene3d-view.tsx:1173` (`main`) and `:1180` (`scene3d-plane-grid-camera`), `const laChieuCao = o.id.includes('cao') || (o.label && /chiều cao/i.test(o.label)) || (o.role && /chiều cao/i.test(o.role));` synthesizes two right-angle markers solely from string matching (`'cao'`) even when `source == 'segment_between'` and no perpendicularity witness exists in `scene.quantities` or `scene.objects`.

counterexamples.category: Hai dấu góc vuông được dựng từ các hướng đã bị phép chiếu đồ họa chỉnh sửa (Two right-angle markers from graphically projected directions)
counterexamples.expected_math: Right-angle markers for a line perpendicular to a plane must have their base legs aligned with actual constructed rays/edges `(foot -> P_i)` in that plane (as `projectionWitnessesAt` does via `plane_point_ids`), NOT arbitrary Gram-Schmidt projections of the world `[1,0,0]` / `[0,1,0]` axes.
counterexamples.root_cause: In `frontend/src/simulations/domains/geometry/scene3d-camera.ts:375-383` (`khungGocVuong`) called by `scene3d-view.tsx:1178-1204`, `e1 = normalize(truc - (truc·d)d)` and `e2 = d × e1` are synthesized by projecting the world coordinate axis `truc = [1,0,0]` (or `[0,1,0]`) orthogonal to `d` and drawing two right-angle markers `[e1, d]` and `[e2, d]`. When `d` is tilted or the base polygon is rotated, `e1` and `e2` point into empty space (`sin(e1, AB) = 0.2981 != 0`, `|e1_z| = 0.2357 != 0`) instead of lying along actual constructed lines in the plane.

counterexamples.category: Ba điểm thẳng hàng khi được dùng để xác định mặt phẳng (Three collinear points used to define a plane)
counterexamples.expected_math: (B - A) × (M - A) = (0, 0, 0); three collinear points span a 1D line and leave the plane normal underdetermined (1-parameter family of planes). Must fail-closed.

oracle_failures: Plane plane_ABM constructed from collinear points ['A', 'B', 'M'] (||u x v||=0.000e+00)

counterexamples.root_cause: Backend kernel `Plane3.through(a, b, c)` (`backend/app/simulation/geometry/kernel.py:194-199`) checks `if n.is_zero(): raise GeometryError(ERR_THANG_HANG, ...)` and refuses collinear plane triples fail-closed. Our independent oracle (`1_incidence`) also independently checks `||(P2-P1) x (P3-P1)|| > TOL` on every `construct_plane` object.
